title: The prescribing act itself must conform to all the named instruments
rule_summary: Under 105 CMR 700.003(G)(3) the pharmacist issues, modifies or discontinues a prescription or medication order IN ACCORDANCE WITH M.G.L. c. 112, s. 24B1/2, 105 CMR 700.000, 247 CMR 16.00, 243 CMR 2.12, AND THE COLLABORATIVE PRACTICE AGREEMENT between the pharmacist and supervising physician established in accordance with 247 CMR 16.00 and 243 CMR 2.12.
exam_relevance: Tests that the act, and not only the pharmacist's credentials, must conform to each of the four named bodies of law and to the agreement, so a prescription written outside the agreement's terms fails this condition even where every registration is in order.

authority.name: Massachusetts Department of Public Health regulations

common_confusions: This subparagraph governs the act; 105 CMR 700.003(G)(1) governs the pharmacist's standing with the Board of Registration in Pharmacy.
verification_notes: Read in the current official publication of 105 CMR 700.000 at the Department of Public Health download link on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule rather than by changing an existing record, so that no released adjudication is disturbed.
